title: Microsoft 365 admin center: authoritative SharePoint sites for Copilot Search
summary: Hold: the briefing says the full SharePoint navigation is undocumented, but Microsoft documents how to reach the site list. The feature, rollout and commands are otherwise supported; the SharePoint route needs that navigation added, and the differing tenant-level and administrator licensing statements should be reported together.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; What's changing; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 admin center control is at Copilot > Search > Authoritative content.
claims.quote: Go to Microsoft 365 Admin Center and select Copilot > Search > Authoritative content.

claims.claim: An API specifically documented for the Microsoft 365 admin center authoritative-content list is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "authoritative content" "Copilot Search" "API"; opened authoritative-sites, Set-SPOSite, release-notes and Search API overview. Found site-designation APIs, but no passage tying an API to the admin center list.

claims.claim: The SharePoint admin center route selects a site and then Mark as authoritative site.
claims.quote: Open the SharePoint admin center. Select a site and choose 'Mark as authoritative site.'
claims.fix: Expand controls[1].ui.path and its rendered table cell to 'Sites > Active sites > site > Mark as authoritative site'. Add https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/manage-sites-in-new-admin-center to sources; it documents 'Sites > Active sites' followed by selecting a site. Retain the release-notes docs link for the designation action.

claims.claim: Set-SPOSite -Identity <site URL> -IsAuthoritative $true marks an individual site authoritative.
claims.quote: Set-SPOSite -Identity "https://<tenant>.sharepoint.com/sites/<siteName>" -IsAuthoritative $true

claims.claim: Running Set-SPOSite requires a SharePoint Online administrator who is also a site collection administrator.
claims.quote: You must be a SharePoint Online administrator and be a site collection administrator to run the cmdlet.

claims.claim: The SharePoint authoritative-sites page documents CSOM automation and bulk designation operations.
claims.quote: Use CSOM when you need automation or bulk operations. $results = $tenant.BulkSetResourceAsAuthoritative($siteIds)

claims.claim: The documented CSOM setup registers an Entra ID app with Sites.FullControl.All application permissions.
claims.quote: -SharePointApplicationPermissions "Sites.FullControl.All" -GraphDelegatePermissions "Sites.FullControl.All" -GraphApplicationPermissions "Sites.FullControl.All"

claims.claim: Authoritative sites identify official organization-managed SharePoint sources whose content Copilot Search recognizes as trusted.
claims.quote: Authoritative sites help administrators identify official, organization-managed SharePoint sources. When you mark a site as authoritative, Copilot Search experiences recognize its content as trusted.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated what authoritative-content management does on arrival before any administrator configures it.
claims.quote: Searched: "authoritative sites" "default"; "authoritative sites" "Copilot Search" default same list admin center PowerShell licensing. Read roadmap, MC1526676, feature page, release-notes passages and Set-SPOSite -IsAuthoritative; no feature default is stated.

claims.claim: No source states that this new control changes existing search behavior before sites are designated.
claims.quote: Searched: "authoritative sites" "default"; "authoritative sites" "Copilot Search" default same list admin center PowerShell licensing. Read roadmap, MC1526676, feature page and release-notes feature passages; no pre-designation behavior change is stated.

claims.where: controls[1].note; What's changing; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn does not explicitly state whether the admin center list and PowerShell or CSOM designation use the same list.
claims.quote: Searched: "authoritative sites" "admin center" "same" "PowerShell". Read authoritative-sites, Set-SPOSite, Copilot Search admin experience and release-notes passages; none explicitly links the admin center list to the PowerShell/CSOM list.

claims.claim: Learn does not explicitly state whether the two routes share one 100-site limit.
claims.quote: Searched: "authoritative sites" "admin center" "same" "PowerShell"; "authoritative sites" "Copilot Search" default same list admin center PowerShell licensing. Read feature limitations and release-notes passages: both say 100, but neither explains a shared limit.

claims.claim: The SharePoint authoritative-sites page itself provides no admin center UI steps for site designation.
claims.quote: Searched: "authoritative sites" "admin center" "same" "PowerShell". Opened and read the entire authoritative-sites page; its configuration procedures use PowerShell and CSOM, not admin center UI designation steps.

claims.claim: The Microsoft 365 Copilot release notes list authoritative-content management under 4 November 2026.
claims.quote: November 4, 2026. Authoritative content management for Microsoft 365 Copilot Search [Web]. Roadmap ID: 503553.

claims.claim: The Copilot Search admin-experience page covers the Search module, bookmarks and acronyms but not authoritative-content management.
claims.quote: Searched: "authoritative content" "Copilot Search" "import" "format". Read the entire Copilot Search admin-experience page: it gives Copilot > Search and bookmark/acronym procedures, but no authoritative-content procedure.

claims.claim: Microsoft advises reviewing the authoritative-sites list regularly and removing outdated or no-longer-official sites.
claims.quote: Review the list regularly and remove outdated or no-longer-official sites.

claims.claim: The described capability is administrator-maintained site designation for search relevance, not a described autonomous action.
claims.quote: Specify and manage SharePoint sites deemed as authoritative content to enhance their relevance and ranking in Microsoft 365 Copilot Search.

claims.claim: A defined file format for authoritative-content bulk import and export is not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "authoritative content" "Copilot Search" "import" "format". Read release-notes feature passages, authoritative-sites and Copilot Search admin experience; found bulk UX options and unrelated bookmark/acronym CSV formats, not this list's format.

claims.where: Governance controls: paragraph beginning The SharePoint page
claims.claim: The full navigation to the SharePoint site-designation control is not documented.
claims.quote: In the SharePoint admin center, select Sites > Active sites or browse to the Active sites page. In the left column, select a site.
claims.fix: Replace 'the full navigation path is not documented, so none is given here beyond those two steps' with 'The site-selection navigation is documented on Manage sites in the SharePoint admin center; the designation action is documented in the 11 August 2026 release notes.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/manage-sites-in-new-admin-center alongside the existing release-notes link. The complete route is 'Sites > Active sites > site > Mark as authoritative site'.
